name: io.github.dienhokhanh/mcp-openai-ads
title: OpenAI Ads (ChatGPT Ads)
description: Report on and manage OpenAI Ads (ads in ChatGPT) campaigns, ad groups and ads.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Advertiser API key from OpenAI Ads Manager > Settings

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable create/update/pause tools (default: read-only)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum report rows returned per call (default 200)
